message.text: `store/migration/sqlite/LATEST.sql` contains the complete current schema for a fresh SQLite installation.

q10.
store/migration/sqlite/LATEST.sql

`store/migrator.go` applies `LATEST.sql` on uninitialized databases (`LatestSchemaFileName`). For SQLite that file is `store/migration/sqlite/LATEST.sql`.
